A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]] '''officer''' operated on [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], he provided [[Renegade Squadron/Legends|Renegade Squadron]] with information regarding supply [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttles]] that came to the planet from the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Conqueror (superlaser)|''Conqueror'']].
